conclusions_supported_now: The generic critic spontaneously names position/layout, orientation, proportions, and material/texture in recorded cases, overlapping the broad kinds in the provisional principle, without per-case human agreement being known.

The additional principle is associated with changed priorities and sometimes category or severity, often without changing the first category or score. Shared diagnoses, reversals, and conflicts all occur.
conclusions_not_supported: Improved human alignment, validated universal weights, actual reconstruction improvement from a higher automated score, semantic or 3D correctness, or population-level preference.
Causal attribution of every difference to the principle rather than session stochasticity, or independent statistical inference from correlated versions and only two new scenes.
Human labels, T2/T3 training or execution, technical diagnosis, exploration guidance, or student capability learning in this batch.
next_steps_after_genuine_human_feedback: Obtain separate genuine offline development and independent exports; preserve the frozen T0/T1 predictions and inspect human scores, prioritized defects, pair preferences and disagreements without treating the model as a rater.

Use development labels only for future T2 examples and, after real disagreements and a separate future selection split, T3 process evolution. Keep independent scenes held out from all adjustment; evaluate after freezing the new teacher.

Report agreement and disagreements by scene and rater with uncertainty, without claiming general human preferences from one rater; consider additional independently sampled scenes and repeated model sessions.
